summary: A public Instagram summons no longer carries group-chat instructions: it answers in the comment's language and cites links a stranger can open.
details: The summons prompt no longer carries the group's default language, so an English comment is answered in English.
How a group chat's picture placeholders read moved out of the core hard rules into a room-only file, so it no longer reaches a public reply; group turns get the same words as before.
On the public surface, a citation is a full link or the site's name, never a shortened one, and a post's picture or video marked as not read is never described.
limitations: Not measured against the eval suite or a live summons; the next dry-run trace is the read-back.
